high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @ArtifactsHub, which is associated with the "Archaeology" category. The tweet was posted 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. It announces an archaeological discovery made by a team led by Professor Kutalmış Görkay of the University of Ankara in Turkey. The team has unearthed three ancient Greek mosaics from the 2nd century BC in the Turkish city of Zeugma, near the border with Syria. The tweet includes a photograph showing two archaeologists working on the mosaic floor.
